description: Body- and facial-hair distribution patterns, density, color, and texture. Excludes pubic-region hair (covered in pubic-region.json) and head hair (covered in head-hair.json). The Ferriman-Gallwey scale (1961) is the canonical clinical reference for terminal-hair density across nine body regions; this vocabulary captures that pattern at observability-appropriate granularity for photograph-based assessment.

dimensions.scale_citation: Ferriman D, Gallwey JE (1961). Clinical assessment of body hair growth in women. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 21(11): 1440-1447.
dimensions.description: Visual estimate of overall terminal-hair density. The original 0-36 numeric scale (0-3 across nine body regions) summed to a clinical hirsutism cutoff; this dimension uses qualitative buckets that aggregate the per-region scores for photograph-based assessment.

values.definition: Below clinical hirsutism threshold; minimal visible body hair.
Borderline; some terminal hair across body regions.
Above clinical hirsutism threshold for women; substantial terminal hair distribution.

observability.notes: Reliable visual estimation requires multiple body regions visible. Grooming/hair-removal substantially confounds native-density assessment.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with descriptors used in dermatology and trichology literature on terminal-hair distribution patterns.
dimensions.description: Distribution and density of facial hair in subjects with apparent male physiognomy.

values.definition: Uneven coverage with visible bare patches.
Recently shaved; native density not directly assessable.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with descriptors used in trichology literature on chest-hair patterns.
dimensions.description: Pattern and density of terminal chest hair in subjects with apparent male physiognomy.

values.definition: Hair limited to a vertical central band.
Hair across the chest but not extending to abdomen.
Continuous distribution from chest to abdomen.
Visible removal; native distribution not assessable.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with terminal-hair distribution descriptors in dermatology literature.
dimensions.description: Pattern of abdominal hair, including the 'happy trail' linea alba pattern.

values.definition: Vertical strip from navel to pubis only.
Visible removal; native pattern not assessable.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with terminal-hair descriptors in dermatology literature.
dimensions.description: Density of arm hair on the dorsal forearm.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with terminal-hair descriptors in dermatology literature.
dimensions.description: Density of leg hair (anterior tibial / calf region).

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with terminal-hair descriptors in dermatology literature.
dimensions.description: Distribution of back hair in subjects with apparent male physiognomy.

dimensions.scale_citation: Aligned with trichology descriptors of differential body / scalp hair pigmentation.
dimensions.description: Body-hair color relative to scalp hair.
